Restart this deal

A THOUGHTFUL LITTLE MATCH

Find your next move.

Choose a phase you need versus exploit a likely rival selection; retain useful building card or spend it to build another; produce now anticipating opponent shipping or deny free action by changing role.

Take a seat
How to play
Each player begins two tableau buildings and six cards; four round phases: Explore draw, Develop build, Produce stock, Ship consume. Human and bot simultaneously choose one; union executes in printed order, once per phase. Selector gets phase-specific bonus. Build by discarding other hand cards as payment; built buildings give permanent exact effects or storage. Production fills empty producers; shipping empties chosen stocks for cards or VP. Twelve rounds or six buildings ends.
VP tokens plus printed building VP higher than opponent wins; equal draw. Short rules table lists every building effect.
Controls & access

How to play
Each player begins two tableau buildings and six cards; four round phases: Explore draw, Develop build, Produce stock, Ship consume. Human and bot simultaneously choose one; union executes in printed order, once per phase. Selector gets phase-specific bonus. Build by discarding other hand cards as payment; built buildings give permanent exact effects or storage. Production fills empty producers; shipping empties chosen stocks for cards or VP. Twelve rounds or six buildings ends.
VP tokens plus printed building VP higher than opponent wins; equal draw. Short rules table lists every building effect.

How to play
Twenty-four square tiles have roads, city sides and fields; drawn tile rotates and must match every adjacent edge. After placement optionally put one of five claimants on an unclaimed connected road/city on that tile; cannot enter already claimed connected feature. Merging separately claimed features allowed. Completed road closed at junction/end both ends; city closed on every exposed city edge. Majority claimants score feature, ties all score; claimants return. End incomplete features score half rounded down.
Higher feature score after tile stock ends wins, equal draw; house victory natural loss.
